{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_count}')

# Confirm they are exactly 6
assert qa_count == 6, 'Expected exactly 6 QA orders'

# Drop QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Verify status is only 'completed' or 'refunded'
print(f'Unique values in status: {df["status"].unique()}')

# Only keep completed orders
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Confirm data is cleaned
df.info()"}
